details: Initial `cargo test --manifest-path crates/herder-compat/Cargo.toml --test handshakes -- --nocapture` ran >60s without completing; the test awaited server ServiceExt::serve inline, so its transport reader could not run concurrently with the client handshake. No native endpoint or external effect was involved.

resolution.reason: The timeout was caused solely by the in-memory test harness waiting for a server ServiceExt::serve call inline; it was not a product protocol defect. The test now runs each server reader concurrently and the same wire check completes successfully; see review-evidence/run-01a1b398/green-B7-B64.txt.
